name: About Haptic.md
content:
# About Haptic

Haptic is a home for your markdown notes. It's quiet, quick, and stays out of the way — all you need and nothing you don't.

## Your notes stay yours

Everything you write is stored **on this device, in this browser**. There's no account, and nothing is uploaded anywhere.

That also means the reverse: if you clear your browser's site data, your notes go with it. If something matters, keep a copy elsewhere too.

## Writing

Notes open in **view mode**, so you can read one without changing it by accident. Press `⌘E` — or click the pencil in the toolbar — to start editing, and again to stop.

There's no save button. Haptic saves as you type. `⌘S` saves immediately if you'd rather be sure.

Markdown works the way you'd expect:

- `#` for headings
- `**bold**` and `_italic_`
- `-` for a list, `- [ ]` for a checkbox
- Three backticks for a code block

## Organising

Your notes live in a **collection** — the set of notes and folders in the sidebar on the left.

- `⌘N` makes a note, `⌘⇧N` a folder
- Drag notes between folders to move them
- Hover a note and press `R` to rename, `D` to duplicate, `⌘⌫` to delete
- `⌘O` opens a different collection, or brings in a folder of `.md` files from your computer

## Good to know

**Tables aren't supported yet.** The editor can't show markdown tables, and opening a note containing one will drop the table the next time that note saves. Keep those notes somewhere else until table support arrives.

**Sync isn't here yet.** Notes don't travel between devices, or between the web and desktop apps, for now.

name: Daily notes and tasks.md
content:
# Daily notes and tasks

Two views sit alongside your notes in the left rail.

## Daily

**Daily** gives you one note per day — somewhere to put what's going on without naming a file or deciding where it belongs.

Pick a date on the calendar and start writing. Nothing is created until you actually type something, so wandering through the calendar won't leave a trail of empty notes behind you.

## Tasks

Anything written as a checkbox becomes a task:

- [ ] an open task, like this one
- [x] and one that's already done

**Tasks** collects every unchecked box from every note in the collection into a single list, grouped by the note it came from. Click a line to jump straight to it in place.

There's nothing to set up — write a checkbox anywhere and it turns up here.

## Finding things

- `⌘⇧F` searches every note in the collection
- `⌘F` searches inside the note you're reading
- `⌘K` opens the command menu, the fastest route to anything
- `⌘J` jumps to a note by name

## Making it yours

`⌘,` opens settings: light or dark, editor and interface fonts, text size, spellcheck, and how eagerly auto-save fires.

`⌘⇧T` flips between light and dark on the spot.

name: Keyboard shortcuts.md
content:
# Keyboard shortcuts

On Windows and Linux, use `Ctrl` wherever this list says `⌘`.

## Getting around

- `⌘K` — command menu
- `⌘J` — jump to a note by name
- `⌘⇧F` — search the whole collection
- `⌘F` — search this note
- `⌘⌥←` and `⌘⌥→` — back and forward through notes you've opened

## Writing

- `⌘E` — switch between reading and editing
- `⌘S` — save now
- `⌘N` — new note
- `⌘⇧N` — new folder
- `⌘⇧M` — move this note to another folder

## Hovering a note or folder

Point at something in the sidebar, then press:

- `R` — rename it
- `D` — duplicate it
- `N` — new note inside it
- `F` — new folder inside it
- `⌘⌫` — delete it

## The app

- `⌘O` — open a collection
- `⌘,` — settings
- `⌘/` — this list, inside the app
- `⌘⇧S` — show or hide the sidebar
- `⌘I` — details for the current note
- `⌘⇧T` — light or dark
